summary: Verified iter 74 deliverables end-to-end: (1) PERSONA-1 audit inventory (248 rows, 0 ambiguities, sections all present, regeneration matches). (2) Onboarding auto-save backend (6/6 pytest pass) + full UI flow (pill saving→saved, toast on reload, fields prefilled, pill hidden in edit mode, DELETE-on-finish wired). (3) PPC milestone backend (4/4 pytest pass) + banner UI (shows at $120 crossing $100 with heading + total-saved pill, does NOT reappear after reload, does NOT show below $100). (4) PPC regression: 41 passed / 1 skipped, no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx (1053 lines) is over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting Step1/Step2/Step3/StepAllDone into separate files to keep the parent shell + auto-save logic readable.

onboarding_draft.py rejects payloads >32 KB with 413 but does not clamp/prune before rejecting — a caregiver in the middle of typing on a slow tab could silently start hitting 413 with no UI signal. Consider surfacing draftStatus.state='error' when a PUT returns 413 (already handled in the catch block, but the UX doesn't call out 'form too big').

PriceCheckerHistory.jsx MILESTONE_TIERS is authored twice conceptually (frontend const + backend whitelist). If the ladder changes, both must be edited. Not a blocker — worth a shared constant/config.

MilestoneBanner auto-dismisses after 12s but marks the milestone the moment it renders (via POST /mark). Fine for one-shot semantics, but if a user reloads within the same 12s window they would already miss the celebration (this is actually the intended behavior per spec — no bug, just documenting).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 PPC checks (TESTPROV Personal care 150→30, delta $120) to trigger milestone banner, and later (TESTPROV2 TEST_LOWSAVE 80→30, delta $50) for the below-$100 negative case. Both fully cleaned from ppc_saved_checks + ppc_provider_aggregate. Reset ppc_milestones for trial user (all four thresholds back to null). Cleared onboarding_drafts for trial user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: trial30909@example.com has an already-onboarded participant (Dottie); visiting /onboarding without ?new=1 automatically appends ?pid=<uuid> (edit mode) so the auto-save pill is hidden by design. Use /onboarding?new=1 for the fresh-participant test. The bulk-delete endpoint DELETE /api/ppc/checks/provider requires BOTH provider AND service as query params — not just provider. Direct mongo cleanup of ppc_saved_checks + ppc_provider_aggregate is simpler for teardown.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All three shippable items verified in production preview env.
